Metadata.title: Delta Aman | Electromechanical Contracting
Metadata.description: Integrated electromechanical, fire protection, maintenance and industrial supply solutions for Egyptian facilities.

Hero.title: Built for demanding sites.
Hero.description: Delta Aman brings electrical, fire protection, mechanical, maintenance and procurement scopes together for industrial and commercial facilities across Egypt.
Hero.panelText: From site survey and technical submittals to supply, installation, testing and handover.

About.title: Practical engineering for Egypt’s working facilities.
About.textOne: Delta Aman is a fictional Egyptian B2B engineering and contracting brand created for this demonstration. Its service model reflects the day-to-day needs of factories, warehouses, commercial buildings and infrastructure operators.
About.textTwo: The company is positioned around clear coordination, sensible material selection, disciplined site execution and responsive maintenance support.
About.note: Demo company profile — no certifications, client claims or project figures are implied.
About.imageAlt: Industrial safety helmet on a dark background

Services.title: Technical scopes managed under one roof
Services.intro: A focused service mix for new installations, upgrades and ongoing facility support.

electrical.title: Electrical & Low Voltage
electrical.text: Power distribution, panels, containment, lighting, earthing and low-current system installation.

fire.title: Fire Protection Systems
fire.text: Firefighting networks, pumps, alarms, testing and coordinated maintenance support.

mechanical.title: Mechanical & Piping
mechanical.text: Utility piping, pumps, valves and mechanical installation for industrial and commercial sites.

maintenance.title: Facility Maintenance
maintenance.text: Planned and corrective maintenance for critical electromechanical assets and building services.

procurement.title: Industrial Procurement
procurement.text: Technical sourcing for electrical, mechanical, safety and facility consumables with clear specifications.

hse.title: HSE Site Support
hse.text: Practical safety documentation, toolbox coordination and site controls aligned with project needs.

Sectors.title: Built around the way Egyptian sites operate
Sectors.intro: Our scopes are structured for facilities where uptime, safety and practical site coordination matter.

Work.title: Representative scopes, clearly defined
Work.intro: These examples illustrate the kind of work the demo company is designed to undertake; they are not claimed completed projects.

factory.title: Factory electrical upgrade
factory.text: Panel replacement, cable routing, load coordination and phased testing planned around production windows.

warehouse.title: Warehouse fire package
warehouse.text: Fire alarm and firefighting coordination covering equipment selection, installation, testing and handover files.

facility.title: Preventive maintenance program
facility.text: Asset register, inspection plan, priority matrix and scheduled support for electrical and mechanical systems.

Process.title: A clear route from inquiry to handover

survey.title: Survey
survey.text: Understand the site, operating constraints and required outcomes.

proposal.title: Technical proposal
proposal.text: Define scope, materials, interfaces, schedule and commercial assumptions.

delivery.title: Execution
delivery.text: Coordinate supply and installation with documented site controls.

handover.title: Testing & handover
handover.text: Verify the work and provide the agreed closeout documentation.
